reason: I only take gummies or drinks, I hate swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules every night. The sachet is handy for travel, but it does not change that I would not take them.
objection: It is capsules, two of them. I do not swallow pills, so it would sit in a drawer. And I would still wonder if I would actually feel a difference.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink-mix version of the same magnesium bisglycinate at a similar price.
